kept.name: e:dr-backplane
kept.depicts: A cyan bus rail holding four magenta card sockets, three populated with vertical expansion boards of varying heights and one left empty.
An open hard-drive chassis with corner mounting screws, a spinning cyan magnetic platter, a white spindle hub, and a magenta-pivoted read/write actuator arm.

kept.name: e:dr-chip
kept.depicts: A magenta-framed black dual-inline integrated circuit with a white pin-one dot and cyan legs, appearing in ten-pin and fourteen-pin widths.
A flat cyan parallel ribbon cable with a mid-span twist and an animated pulse gap running along its conductors.

kept.name: e:dr-irq
kept.depicts: A ten-pin magenta-framed controller chip with a cyan status bar and vertical headroom above it for an animated interrupt discharge.
A horizontal USB Type-A plug with a magenta cable tail, a white molded grip marked in cyan, and a slotted metal shield.

kept.name: e:dr-pcie
kept.depicts: A horizontal cyan-outlined PCI Express expansion slot with a notched partition, magenta rail, and white contact pins along the bottom.
A cyan-framed network expansion card with a magenta controller die, a white link LED, bottom edge contacts, and a detached black rear bracket.

kept.name: e:dr-gpu
kept.depicts: A magenta-shrouded graphics card with twin spinning white-and-cyan cooling fans and a cyan PCIe edge connector underneath.

kept.name: e:dr-keys
kept.depicts: Three staggered rows of white keycaps with cyan undersides, including a wide spacebar on the bottom row.
A magenta-shelled nine-pin D-subminiature port with black side mounting ears and nine staggered cyan contacts.

kept.name: e:dr-scope
kept.depicts: A black oscilloscope display tracing an animated cyan sine wave across magenta center ticks, flanked by three magenta rotary dials.

kept.name: e:dr-dip
kept.depicts: A magenta six-position DIP switch block with five white toggles flipped up and the third flipped down.
A top-down white two-button computer mouse with a cyan cord at the top and a magenta scroll wheel between the buttons.

rework.name: e:dr-dma
rework.depicts: A white perforated transfer track carrying three sliding magenta and cyan data blocks between two cyan endpoints.
A small black storage module streaming cyan data pulses leftward-to-rightward into an eight-pin magenta-framed controller chip.
A tiny six-by-five-pixel scuttling bug with a white carapace ridge, a cyan or magenta rectangular body, and two white legs centered in a large empty canvas.

deleted.name: e:dr-connector
deleted.depicts: A compact black rectangular socket housing nine staggered cyan pins arranged five over four.
deleted.reason: Too similar to the COM1 Port, which is a stronger, more recognizable 9-pin serial connector.

deleted.depicts: Three vertical cyan electrolytic capacitors with white metallic tops and dual lead pins, the middle cylinder slightly shorter.
deleted.reason: Generic motherboard component filler without a distinct device driver concept.

deleted.depicts: A compact cyan-framed square drive containing a spinning white magnetic platter, black spindle cross, and diagonal magenta actuator arm.
deleted.reason: Too similar to Spinning Rust, both depicting a spinning magnetic platter and actuator arm.

deleted.name: e:dr-jumpers
deleted.depicts: A black two-by-five header block of cyan pins with two vertical pairs bridged by magenta plastic shunts.
deleted.reason: Too similar to the DIP Switch, which is a more recognizable hardware configuration prop.

deleted.name: e:dr-heatsink
deleted.depicts: Eight tall vertical white cooling fins rising evenly from a solid cyan baseplate.
deleted.reason: Generic passive cooling hardware filler without a driver-specific concept.

deleted.name: e:dr-rj45
deleted.depicts: A square black modular Ethernet jack with a cyan contact bar inside, a bottom latch cutout, and magenta and cyan status LEDs above.
deleted.reason: Redundant networking hardware prop alongside the eth0 Card.

deleted.depicts: A white loudspeaker cone backed by a cyan driver box, emitting cyan and white sound-wave arcs to the right.
deleted.reason: Generic low-priority peripheral filler compared to core driver devices.

deleted.depicts: A rounded white metallic quartz-crystal oscillator can with a dark face and two cyan leads extending downward.
deleted.reason: Generic board-level component filler with low priority and little driver-specific meaning.

deleted.name: e:dr-sata
deleted.depicts: A magenta-framed black SATA receptacle containing a cyan horizontal contact blade with a white L-shaped keying tab on the right.
deleted.reason: Weak standalone port prop; storage is already well represented by Spinning Rust and NVMe Stick.

deleted.depicts: A white-bordered black rectangular shroud enclosing four vertical cyan pins.
deleted.reason: Generic low-priority motherboard header filler without a strong driver concept.

deleted.depicts: A narrow magenta circuit strip studded with four alternating cyan and white glowing LEDs.
deleted.reason: Generic diagnostic LED filler with low priority.

deleted.name: e:dr-nvme
deleted.depicts: A horizontal cyan-edged M.2 solid-state drive stick with two magenta NAND flash packages and a white edge-connector end.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 1: pink boxes; nothing reads as a drive
